title: fix(app-shell,components): Add region writes only a slot the template places; a template-less page is judged as default (objectui#12902)
body:
Fixes #12902
Clause-②: no

## What changes

Against `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.3 (`PAGE_TEMPLATE_SLOTS`, `PAGE_TEMPLATE_OPEN_GRID`, `checkPageRegionPlacement`):

1. **Studio's "Add region" writes only a name the template places** (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PageBlockCanvas.tsx`).
   - New `regionOffer(draft, regions)`: the template the page is judged under (`template ?? 'default'`, as the spec reads it), the slots of `PAGE_TEMPLATE_SLOTS[template]` no region fills yet (matched case-insensitively, as the spec matches), and, on an open-grid template (`dashboard`), one fresh grid cell name no region uses. The slot list is read from the spec by reference; there is no hand-copied list.
   - "Add region" opens a menu of exactly those names (`data-add-region`). `addRegion(name)` writes only a name the offer holds.
   - Nothing left to offer (every slot filled, or a template the spec does not declare): the button is disabled and the reason sits beside it, wired by `aria-describedby` (`data-add-region-reason`).
   - The slot-fill write in `addBlock` (a missing region at the target index) names the first offered slot instead of a positional `region_N`.
   - New copy in the designer's own string tables, en and zh: `engine.pageBlockCanvas.gridCell`, `engine.pageBlockCanvas.addRegionAllFilled`, `engine.pageBlockCanvas.addRegionUnknownTemplate`.
2. **A template-less `kind: 'full'` page is judged as `default`** (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`).
   - New `templateLessJudgement(schema)`: `'default'` when `(schema.kind ?? 'full') === 'full'`, the same reading the spec's placement check makes. The four `pageType` layouts (record, home, app, utility) pass it to `RegionLayout`, so a region `default` does not place goes through objectui#12476's `UnplacedRegionsRefusal` instead of stacking under `main`. No new refusal surface.
   - A page of another kind, which the spec's placement check does not judge, keeps the stacking.

## Built-in pages checked before the renderer change

In-code producers of page regions on `main` (`git grep` over `packages/*/src`, `apps/*/src`, `examples/`, tests excluded):

- `apps/console/src/preview-samples.ts` `crm_welcome`: `type: 'home'`, no template, one region `main`. This is the only built-in page that reaches the template-less path.
- `plugin-detail` `buildDefaultPageSchema`: `template: 'default'`, regions `main` and `aside`. Not template-less.
- `PagePreview` `handleAddBlock`: writes `main` when a page has no region. `anchors.ts` seeds from `buildDefaultPageSchema`.
- `cli generate`: a `children` page, no regions.

Both pages were rendered through `SchemaRenderer` with this change, in a scratch test that was then deleted: 0 refusals each.

## Tests

- New `PageBlockCanvas.regionSlots-12902.test.tsx` (8 tests). On no template, `default`, `header-sidebar-main` and `three-column`, it drives "Add region" until nothing is left. Each time it asserts the menu offers exactly the unfilled slots. It runs the spec's `checkPageRegionPlacement` on every draft produced and expects no issue. At the end the button is disabled with its reason. On `dashboard` it offers header, footer and a grid cell, and every produced draft passes the spec check. An undeclared template is disabled.
- New `page-template-less-12902.test.tsx` (9 tests). On a template-less record, home, app or utility page, `region_2` is drawn nowhere and refused by name, and the spec check refuses the same names. An explicit `kind: 'full'` behaves the same. A page with only unplaced regions draws only the refusal. CONTROLS: `main` + `aside`, and all five `default` slots, draw with no refusal.
- `page-template-slots-12476.test.tsx`: the pin that a template-less page stacks `region_2` asserted the branch this card removes. It now pins the branch that stays: a `kind: 'slotted'` page still stacks.
- Targeted run (the three files): 3 files, 35 tests passed.
- Ablation, canvas half: `addRegion` was restored to append `region_${regions.length + 1}` with `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, blob b603a312 to 6e4f3052). Result: 5 failed, 3 passed. The 5 are the four slotted templates and the dashboard run. Restored: blob equal to HEAD b603a312, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation, renderer half: `templateLessJudgement` was made to return `undefined` (blob a8c2e838 to 25cdb2d0). Result: 6 failed, 21 passed. The 6 are the refusal pins; the controls and the 12476 file stayed green. Restored: blob equal to HEAD a8c2e838, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Type-check: `@object-ui/app-shell` exit 0, after building the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure (28 tasks green). `@object-ui/components`: `tsc --noEmit` was clean. Its test project reported one diagnostic, in the scratch test above (deleted since).
- Lint, narrowed to the 6 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors, 23 warnings, with the packages' `eslint .` (inline config honoured). The population is the root `eslint.config.js` and the file count comes from the `--format json` output. Type-aware linting is not enabled, so this diff cannot change the verdict on an untouched file. One new warning is `react-refresh/only-export-components` on the exported `regionOffer`, the same warning the file's other exports already carry.
- Gate battery, all exit 0: phantom-deps, self-import, unreferenced-sources, doc-example-readers, handler-key-reads, side-effects-array, element-data-source-declaration, spec-symbols, action-forward-parity, designer-field-key-parity, icon-record-names, i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-designer-parity, i18n-dead-keys, control-bytes, check-hand-rolled-comment-mask, check-changeset-fixed, changeset-presence, new-line-citations.
- Package directory runs: see the os-dev report on the card. The shared test lock was held by sibling full-package runs for most of this session.


**Patch round (`0a717d5`, CI shard 13):** `node-slot-declaration-11170`'s page-family census placed a region with no name (`regions: [{ components: [...] }]`). A nameless region is not a `default` slot, so a template-less full page now refuses it on screen, and the census read that as the node never reaching the DOM. A nameless region is off-spec too: `PageRegionSchema.name` is required in spec `18.0.0-next.3`. The fixture now names it `main` for `page`, `app`, `utility`, `home` and `record` (their `ui:` twins share it). The census still proves `regions[].components` renders an authored node, and the renderer is unchanged. Rerun on `0a717d5`: 6 files, 103 tests passed (the census, both new files, `page-template-slots-12476`, `dataPreviews.i18n-10862-s3`, `PageBlockCanvas.test`). A sweep of every render test that places regions found no other nameless or non-slot region on a template-less full page.
## Acceptance notes

- `header-sidebar-main` does not place `aside` or `footer`, so on that template "Add region" offers only `header`, `sidebar` and `main`, as the spec does.
- On `dashboard` the grid cell keeps the `region_N` spelling, which the spec accepts there. It is chosen so it never repeats a name the page already holds.
- The refusal on a template-less page reads `'default' places only ...`, the template the spec judges it under.
